finalText:
**Build passes now.** Exit code `0`, 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
2. [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw when a flag was `undefined`. New config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now treats that as disabled.

Remaining warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, not errors.
